scopeNote: Consolidated session findings. Ordered by priority. Most entries are definitive NEGATIVE results or CLOSED defects - absence of a profitable route is itself the finding. Readiness is never implied by the presence of code, a quote, or a rehearsal.

statusLegend.CLOSED_NEGATIVE: Investigated and closed: no action available, with measured reason.
statusLegend.ARMED: Live and authorised to act within caps, currently firing nothing.
statusLegend.VERIFIED: Mechanism proven by pinned rehearsal or journal evidence, not a profit claim.
statusLegend.FIXED: Defect found and corrected, with tests.
statusLegend.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed for an infrastructure or authority reason.

priorityLegend.P0: Blocks the objective or records a decisive negative.
priorityLegend.P1: Live capability that can act now.

At a ~2.6% bonus that is ~$3.16 gross across 129 transactions against ~$12.90 of gas.
findings.action: Do not scan Morpho Ethereum/Base for liquidation targets again without a market-structure change.

findings.title: Oracle integrity and manipulability sweep
findings.summary: Oracle composition resolved for all 25 distinct Morpho oracles behind tracked #M* markets: 15 FEED_ONLY, 7 VAULT_ONLY, 1 FEED+VAULT, 1 GETTERS_NO_FEED, 1 NO_KNOWN_GETTER. The seven VAULT_ONLY oracles derive price purely from an ERC-4626 conversion and are the donation/inflation surface. Staleness validation and manipulability remain unassessable at the interface level because every oracle is an adapter exposing only price().
findings.action: Delegated lane hit a provider policy gate; being completed in the orchestrator lane.

findings.title: Vault share accounting sweep
findings.summary: Closed with two corrections and one refutation. The suspected ~26.7% srUSD redemption loss was an inverted interpretation: previewRedeem(x) returns the srUSD required to receive x rUSD, i.e. ceil(x * 1e8 / currentPrice), so the measured 0.856219 was the inverse of the 1.16792549 price, not a loss. Reservoir redeemFee is 1.67 bps, not 1.67%. yoUSD prices shares from an oracle rather than totalAssets/totalSupply, so the simple donation premise does not apply; yoUSD redeem also returns gross assets while fees reduce the received amount, and insufficient liquidity returns zero and queues while withdraw always reverts UseRequestRedeem().
findings.action: Delegated lane hit a provider policy gate; being completed in the orchestrator lane.

findings.summary: The producer accrues at the pinned parent block while execution lands in the child. At the child where M32 died the real margin was 0.000097640945073089 raw USDtb, erasable by an oracle move of about 1.11e-8. Child-time binding exists only for the dedicated M32 path.

findings.title: Seven of 25 tracked oracles price purely from an ERC-4626 conversion
findings.summary: Morpho oracle adapters behind #M32, #M31, #M7/#M7B, #M44, #M15, #M16 and #M18 expose no Chainlink feed and derive price only from a vault convertToAssets conversion. These are the donation and inflation surface. The remaining 15 are feed-only, one is feed-plus-vault (#M36/#M38), and two are unclassified variants.
findings.action: Feasibility scales inversely with vault totalAssets; measured next in F-20.

findings.title: ynETHx oracle depth is thin relative to the credit extended against it
findings.summary: ynETHx reports totalAssets of only 4,200.29 with assetsPerShare 1.0990521, so roughly 42 WETH (about $98k) moves its oracle about 1 percent and 420 WETH about 10 percent, while a single Morpho market carries $1.67M debt against $1.80M collateral. Direction matters: a donation raises share price and therefore cannot push a position into liquidation.
findings.action: The only exploitable shape is borrowing against inflated collateral, whose net cost is donation times (1 minus attacker ownership share) and needs near-total vault ownership. Not established as profitable; requires a borrow-vector test before promotion.

findings.title: Novelty monitoring coverage is materially stale

findings.title: apyUSD delayed redemption spread is the only positive gross lead, and it is not atomic
findings.summary: The route USDC to apxUSD to apyUSD to redeemForReceipt, wait, claim, back to USDC pays a receipt fee of 3.4% at day 3 falling to 0% at day 20, plus a 0.1% vault unlocking fee. At 10,000 USDC the result is -$225.15 at 3 days, -$43.08 at 12 days and +$118.76 at 20 days; at 100,000 USDC and 20 days it is +$850.10 gross. Financing alone consumes the entire 20-day budget at roughly 21.68% annualized, so conservative net is not quantified.
findings.action: Requires a complete delayed settlement simulation preserving purchase-induced pool changes, then financing, gas and uncertainty. Receipts are nontransferable and governance can change fees for existing receipts. Terminal quotes reused unchanged pinned state.

findings.title: Every tested discounted-acquisition route is gross-negative
findings.summary: Sampled purchases followed by redemption all lost money before gas: USD3 round trip -$107.20 on 10,000 USDC; wstETH -$0.46 and -$4.68 on 1 and 10 ETH; weETH -$2.76 and -$27.87; sfrxETH -$3.98 and -$101.21; sUSDS 9,989.69 USDS; sDAI -$10.36 gross; Base sUSDS 547.98 USDC from 1,000, about -$451.89.
findings.action: Same-asset gross-negative routes cannot be rescued by adding transaction costs. Rejection covers only the sampled venues and sizes, not a global optimum.

findings.title: Large redemption liquidity exists but is not purchasable inventory
findings.summary: Holder-origin redemption calls succeed at scale: sUSDC about 9,997,086 USDC on a 10,000,000 withdrawal, USD3 about 19,994,171 USDC on 20,000,000, yoUSD Ethereum cash 143,521.41 USDC with 100,000 shares instant and 140,000 queued, yoUSD Base cash 157,133.20 USDC, srUSD PSM about 78,040 USDC. None of this establishes that an outside actor can acquire those holders' shares.

findings.title: Double-counted-collateral and donation hypotheses falsified on sampled positions
findings.summary: No simple Morpho double counting: all six sampled borrowers had supplyShares = 0 and health uses collateral once with separately accrued debt. Euler accountLiquidityFull returned exactly one collateral vault holding 370,165.99 syrupUSDC-equivalent shares, so no duplicated entry. All seven sampled positions were healthy at the pin with Euler checkLiquidation returning (0,0). Additional route blockers measured: yUSD redeem reverts paused, sNUSD Curve pool is denylisted, expired Pendle PT market swap reverts MarketExpired, weETH native redemption capacity is zero while its stETH limit is 5,000 stETH with a 10 bps fee, ezETH imposes a 14-day cooldown, and rsETH instant routes are disabled.
findings.action: Recursive-borrowing transaction provenance was not established; these are sampled leveraged positions, not proof of loops.

findings.title: Pyth-unsafe oracle consumer hypothesis falsified across 14 chains
findings.summary: A cross-chain Morpho Blue oracle join inspected 2,852 markets and 113 unique oracles across 14 chains and found zero Pyth-linked markets, zero Pyth-unsafe markets and zero watch candidates, concluding no Pyth-linked liquid high-LLTV market in scope. One row had a failed price static call. The result is consistent with our own probe, where all 25 tracked Morpho oracles respond only to price() because they are adapters, so the Pyth linkage is not visible at the interface.
findings.action: Artifact is dated 2026-06-30, so this is a bounded negative, not proof of current absence; re-running it is cheap if Pyth exposure is ever suspected again.

findings.title: Capital and gas funding are the binding constraint on every route
findings.summary: The account holds effectively no deployable capital: zero USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS and WETH on Ethereum, and 0.004022 USDC on Base. Native gas is present but thin - 0.00207011 ETH on Ethereum, 0.00046612 ETH on Base and 0.00044687 ETH on Arbitrum, roughly 4.84, 1.09 and 1.05 USD. Against the authorised 0.0002 ETH per-transaction spend cap that is about 2 attempts per L2, enough for one genuine opportunity but not for trial and error. Every capital-requiring route therefore cannot be funded, including the apyUSD carry and all discounted-acquisition paths.
findings.action: Only flash-funded liquidation remains actionable, and it needs no principal - just enough gas for one attempt. The apyUSD carry is real but unfundable: it needs about 100,000 USDC and financing is available at 5.03% APR against a breakeven of roughly 15.5% at that size.

findings.title: Ethereum warm-loop processing measured; execution remains held
findings.summary: The general Ethereum CLI supports process persistence, but ordinarily reacquires a pinned session per pass. The additive plain-session warm loop reuses qualification and repins between completed passes. Its retained log records 1,056 attempted passes: 1,055 armed reports followed by a fail-closed PIN_EVIDENCE_INVALIDATED stop at 2026-10-28 05:36:50 UTC. The 1,054 warm armed processing samples have a 2,424.189 ms median and 2,546.140 ms p95. These durations exclude idle head waits; 573 passes repeated the previous head. They are not full head-arrival-to-detection-to-preparation latency, proof of present liveness, or directly comparable to the earlier approximately 7.9 s status-write interval. At 05:52 UTC no Ethereum executor process was present, and its status separately recorded UNVERIFIED_STABLE_VALUATION_CONTAINMENT. The earlier latest-header implementation also stopped at pass 22 on provider skew; the common-height fix did not establish uninterrupted operation.
findings.action: Keep the Ethereum safety hold until exact profit admission and authorization are reconciled by the execution owner. Preserve pin, wallet and approval safeguards; use approved renewal loading rather than rewriting historical approval evidence. Establish head-arrival and eligible preparation timing with a non-signing measurement before making end-to-end latency or competitive-inclusion claims. Missing current profit and liveness evidence remain unknown, not zero or ready.

findings.title: Approval lifecycle repaired; #2K+#2L guarded waiting armed
findings.summary: Historical reproduction at 2026-10-28T05:59:05.224Z: approvedAt checks absent in the underlying Ethereum approval validators and unified revoked=true not rejected; the warm wrapper directly loads primary approvals, overriding the renewal helper. The historical synthetic in-memory negative probes showed future approval accepted by both unified and morpho validators; unified revoked=true accepted, while morpho rejected revoked=true with BATCH_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED. These are Ethereum approval-document checks, not Base L2 validator checks. Lifecycle remediation only is verified: 92 lifecycle tests passed, 0 failed; together with 160 existing focused cases, 252 passed. Separate reconciliation remains 3 passed / 1 failed because the dedicated-Aave test reaches PROFIT_UNVERIFIED before expected expiry rejection; full integration is not green. Both actual unexpired batch validators passed and all eight post-fix in-memory negative controls were rejected. Approval, renewal and amendment bytes, caps and expiry are unchanged; no new grant or authority renewal. Historical next-block/M1 amendments bind historical bytes and are expired. Execution reactivation remains BLOCKED for broad multi-route activation; actual eligible preparation remains unexercised on the natural chain. Separately, user-approved guarded activation moved from the CURRENT #2K-only runner to exactly one CURRENT #2K+#2L runner PID 19916 at 2026-10-28T19:40:26Z, after shared-wallet exclusion and a fresh signing-trapped preflight; the former PID 36732 was stopped, not duplicated. The new scope admits only the exact 5.4 WETH/0.01 floor and 12 WETH/0.1 floor full plans under a 0.00075 ETH local ceiling. Verification found healthy zero-candidate waiting, two actual journals with zero pending and no execution; 274 targeted tests passed. #2A remains unarmed. This is waiting readiness, not natural eligibility, a submission or realized profit. No unauthorized signature or loss is established.
